grammar.q: The handwriting in the margins differs completely from the author’s, so someone else [ ____ ] the notes to the manuscript after his death.
If the club [ ____ ] a clearer rule for breaking ties, it would not need to hold a second ballot every time two members receive the same score.
The supervisor recommended that each new employee [ ____ ] with a mentor at least once a month during the first year.
I wish I [ ____ ] a diary during my trip to Egypt last year, as many details have already faded.
[ ____ ] the researchers known about the error, they would have withdrawn the paper before publication.
Before the wetlands were drained, thousands of migrating birds [ ____ ] stop there every spring on their way north.
Before the tournament begins, the rules for breaking a tie must [ ____ ] to all players so that no one can later dispute whether the result is fair.
Most of the trainees soon became used to [ ____ ] feedback from several mentors at the same time.
If the weather [ ____ ] clear tomorrow, the team will survey the nesting sites along the river.
Some of the letters the historian relied on may [ ____ ] by a rival who wanted to damage the king’s reputation.
The archaeologists [ ____ ] the date on the coin, since the building where it was found is a century younger.
If the editors [ ____ ] the error in the final proof, the entire first printing would have been destroyed.
The cave floor is covered with charcoal and animal bones; early humans [ ____ ] their meals here.
The two essays share whole paragraphs, so the students [ ____ ] them independently.
The museum [ ____ ] the restored map last spring, but the exhibition was postponed because of a controversial dispute over its ownership.
The residents demanded that the commission [ ____ ] the drainage of the wetlands until an independent survey of the endangered wildlife living there had been completed and published.
It is vital that every participant in the survey [ ____ ] anonymous until the results are published.
The fossil record suggests that the region [ ____ ] once covered by a shallow sea full of strange creatures.
Before the highway was built, there [ ____ ] be a quiet stream in the valley where farmers watered their crops.
During the long voyage, the sailors [ ____ ] gather on the deck every evening to hear the captain’s stories.
Employees who have worked from home for years [ ____ ] online meetings now, so they rarely feel nervous on camera.
New writers [ ____ ] discard a first draft too quickly, because even a weak draft can contain ideas worth developing.
Many readers [ ____ ] a familiar protagonist through dozens of novels than meet a new hero in every book.
If the mentors in our company [ ____ ] more diverse, minority employees would find it easier to understand the unwritten rules that shape promotion in the workplace.
If more teachers [ ____ ] with students during the drafting stage, fewer essays would be submitted with the same basic errors, and grading would become far less tedious.
If the historian had given the bills closer attention, she [ ____ ] that the palace cost twice as much as the king had claimed.
If the referees [ ____ ] the data more carefully, the flawed study would never have appeared in a respected journal.
If the city had invested in public transport twenty years ago, its streets [ ____ ] so congested now.
Many new employees wish their mentors [ ____ ] available more often during their first few months.
The novelist describes the ancient city as if she [ ____ ] there herself, though she has never actually visited it.
The new manager talks about the company’s history as if she [ ____ ] here for decades, though she joined last month.
[ ____ ] the forest restored to its original state, the indigenous birds might return to nest along the river.
[ ____ ] the editor noticed the error earlier, the publisher could have avoided recalling thousands of copies.
[ ____ ] you require further information, please contact the mentoring office before the end of the month.
Without the volunteers’ help last spring, the researchers [ ____ ] their survey of the wetland birds before the breeding season ended.
If it were not for the surviving letters, we [ ____ ] almost nothing about the poet’s private life.
The museum guide warned that visitors [ ____ ] touch the fragile old photographs with their bare hands.
The team [ ____ ] so many backup slides, because the committee asked only two questions after the presentation, neither of which concerned the budget.
If the investigators [ ____ ] the witnesses before they left the island, the case would have been solved within days, and crucial evidence would not have been lost for decades.
The engineers [ ____ ] the bridge more thoroughly last year; the cracks that appeared this winter suggest that its structure had already begun to weaken.
Faced with a tie, the members [ ____ ] draw lots than spend another week arguing about the two candidates.
If it were not for the shade of the old oaks, the stream [ ____ ] too warm in summer for the trout that now live in it.
[ ____ ] any member of the jury disagree with the verdict, the judge may ask them to discuss it again.
If the bowerbird [ ____ ] a smaller bower last season, it would have appeared even larger to the visiting females, and it might have attracted more mates.
The number of bird species that depend on the remaining wetlands [ ____ ] fallen sharply since the 1980s.
Most of the documents that historians rely on [ ____ ] by officials who had little interest in the lives of ordinary people, so the picture they offer is far from impartial.
Only after the data had been collected from several countries [ ____ ] how widely the pattern had spread and how little the earlier studies had captured.
The critics [ ____ ] that empathy deepens conflict often point to studies of rival sports fans who celebrate each other’s defeats.
Many students who once avoided [ ____ ] their essays now see feedback from classmates as a natural part of writing.
Readers [ ____ ] by a single detective often follow him through dozens of novels written over several decades.
The tree first draws the nutrients out of its leaves and then [ ____ ] the pathway into them.
The space [ ____ ] the male performs for visiting females is decorated with stones and shells arranged carefully by size.
The new evidence was [ ____ ] more convincing than anything the earlier historians had been able to find in the royal archives.
If the town [ ____ ] its old records, historians would have learned much more about the plague of 1665.

arrange.ko: 만약 그 위원회가 생태학자들의 경고에 귀를 기울였더라면, 그 습지는 지금도 많은 희귀 새들의 서식지일 텐데.
arrange.bogi: would still be / the warnings of ecologists, / if the committee listen to / home to many rare birds. / the wetlands
arrange.ans: If the committee had listened to the warnings of ecologists, the wetlands would still be home to many rare birds.

arrange.ko: 그 의사는 그 환자가 수술 후 적어도 두 주 동안은 무거운 물건을 들지 말아야 한다고 권고했다.
arrange.bogi: for at least two weeks after the surgery. / that the patient / the doctor recommended / doesn’t lift / heavy objects
arrange.ans: The doctor recommended that the patient (should) not lift heavy objects for at least two weeks after the surgery.

arrange.ko: 그 비평가는 마치 자신이 그 시를 직접 쓴 것처럼 그 시의 숨은 의미를 설명했지만, 사실 그는 그것을 처음 읽고 있었다.
arrange.bogi: but in fact he was reading it for the first time. / write it himself, / he / the critic explained the hidden meaning of the poem as if
arrange.ans: The critic explained the hidden meaning of the poem as if he had written it himself, but in fact he was reading it for the first time.

arrange.ko: 매일 짧은 일기를 쓰는 것은 학생들이 자신의 생각을 더 분명하게 정리하도록 돕는 것 같다.
arrange.bogi: students organize their thoughts more clearly. / writing a short journal every day / seem to help
arrange.ans: Writing a short journal every day seems to help students organize their thoughts more clearly.

arrange.ko: 그 비평가들의 주장에 따르면, 경쟁은 협력보다 더 많은 혁신을 낳는다.
arrange.bogi: produces more innovation / the critics argue, / competition, / than cooperation does.
arrange.ans: Competition, the critics argue, produces more innovation than cooperation does.

arrange.ko: 인터넷은 학습의 초점을 정보를 기억하는 것에서 그것을 평가하는 것으로 옮겨 놓았다.
arrange.bogi: to evaluate it. / the internet has shifted / from remembering information / the focus of learning
arrange.ans: The internet has shifted the focus of learning from remembering information to evaluating it.

arrange.ko: 고대 그리스에서 온 방문자라면 현대 선거에서 제비뽑기가 거의 쓰이지 않는다는 것에 놀랄 것이다.
arrange.bogi: that lotteries are rarely used / a visitor from ancient Greece / in modern elections. / would be surprised
arrange.ans: A visitor from ancient Greece would be surprised that lotteries are rarely used in modern elections.

arrange.ko: 반면에, 등장인물들이 수십 년에 걸쳐 여러 사람의 손을 거친 작품이라면, 그들은 상당히 바뀔 수도 있다.
arrange.bogi: over decades, / they may / are the work of several hands / on the other hand, if characters / change considerably.
arrange.ans: On the other hand, if characters are the work of several hands over decades, they may change considerably.

arrange.ko: 그 수학자는 동료들과 그 문제를 논의했음에 틀림없다. 그녀의 증명이 그들의 이전 생각을 아주 가깝게 반영하고 있기 때문이다.
arrange.bogi: since her proof reflects / the problem with her colleagues, / must discuss / the mathematician / their earlier ideas so closely.
arrange.ans: The mathematician must have discussed the problem with her colleagues, since her proof reflects their earlier ideas so closely.

arrange.ko: 역사학자들은 무엇이 일어났고 그것이 왜 일어났는지를 이해하기 위해 증거를 활용한다.
arrange.bogi: and why it happened. / in order to understand / historians use evidence / what happened
arrange.ans: Historians use evidence in order to understand what happened and why it happened.

arrange.ko: 세 차례 투표 후에도 표가 동점이 아니었더라면, 그 위원회는 후보들 앞에서 제비를 뽑을 필요가 없었을 텐데.
arrange.bogi: would not have needed / be tied after three rounds, / had the votes not / to draw lots in front of the candidates. / the committee
arrange.ans: Had the votes not been tied after three rounds, the committee would not have needed to draw lots in front of the candidates.

translate.en: Allowing lotteries as social outcomes hence seems like a necessity for impartial collective choice.
translate.ko: 따라서 사회적 결과로서 추첨을 허용하는 것은 공정한 집단적 선택을 위해 필요한 것처럼 보인다.

translate.en: Empathy, they argue, can further entrench conflict and force us into an us vs. them mentality.
translate.ko: 공감은 갈등을 한층 더 고착시키고 우리를 ‘우리 대 그들’이라는 사고방식으로 몰아넣을 수 있다고 그들은 주장한다.

translate.en: Process writing shifts the emphasis in teaching writing from evaluation to revision.
translate.ko: 과정 중심 글쓰기는 글쓰기 교육의 강조점을 평가에서 수정으로 옮긴다.

translate.en: You would not be the first; rest assured, even professional mathematicians sometimes have to rely on discussions with colleagues to properly understand problems they are looking at.
translate.ko: 당신이 처음은 아닐 것이다. 안심하라, 전문 수학자들조차 자신이 보고 있는 문제를 제대로 이해하기 위해 때때로 동료들과의 논의에 의존해야 한다.

translate.en: Subsequently, teachers collect and evaluate what students have written.
translate.ko: 그다음에 교사들은 학생들이 쓴 것을 걷어서 평가한다.

translate.en: We know that animals have evolved a variety of patterns to manipulate the perceptions of their predators to afford themselves a modicum of safety.
translate.ko: 우리는 동물이 자신에게 약간의 안전을 확보하기 위해 약탈자의 지각을 조작하는 다양한 방식을 진화시켜 왔다는 것을 알고 있다.

translate.en: Males construct a bower; its function is to provide an arena in which males display to females standing in an avenue that leads up to the bower.
translate.ko: 수컷은 바우어를 짓는데, 그 기능은 바우어로 이어지는 길에 서 있는 암컷에게 수컷이 구애 동작을 보여 주는 무대를 제공하는 것이다.

translate.en: The males decorate the avenue with a variety of objects, such as stones and shells.
translate.ko: 수컷은 돌이나 조개껍데기 같은 다양한 물체로 그 길을 장식한다.

translate.en: But they do not do so in a chaotic manner.
translate.ko: 그러나 그들은 무질서하게 그렇게 하지는 않는다.

translate.en: The larger objects are placed closer to the bower and the smaller objects farther away.
translate.ko: 더 큰 물체는 바우어에 더 가까이, 더 작은 물체는 더 멀리 놓인다.

translate.en: This creates a forced perspective the opposite of the Cinderella Castle; the bower appears smaller than it actually is.
translate.ko: 이것은 ‘신데렐라 성’과는 반대되는 강제 원근감을 만들어 내어, 바우어가 실제보다 더 작아 보인다.

translate.en: Endler and his colleagues suggested that the male courting in the bower now appears larger and thus more attractive to the female.
translate.ko: Endler와 그의 동료들은 바우어에서 구애하는 수컷이 이제 더 커 보이고 그래서 암컷에게 더 매력적으로 보인다고 주장했다.

translate.en: Data on male mating success collected in the wild supports their hypothesis.
translate.ko: 야생에서 수집된 수컷의 짝짓기 성공에 관한 자료는 그들의 가설을 뒷받침한다.
